title: IHI
summary: Japanese heavy-industry group supplying rocket engines and aerospace components.
bodyHtml:
Investment Thesis

IHI builds rocket engines, turbochargers and aerospace components, and has supplied propulsion for Japanese launch vehicles. Its engine work covers liquid-oxygen and hydrocarbon systems, which are central to modern launchers. The group's broader industrial business spans energy, ships and machinery.

Technology Exposure

  • Rocket engines and propulsion
  • Aerospace components
  • Energy and industrial machinery

What To Watch

  • Japanese launch cadence
  • Engine development milestones
  • Industrial order cycle

Record Notes

Editorial brief compiled 19 November 2026 from company disclosures, agency publications and press reporting. Figures are as reported by those sources and have not been independently audited; no live market data is used.
